restrictions: Applies to the selected target poseidon-orchard-r1-prefix-v1 only (one partial round plus the eight fixed full rounds); the construction uses the first two full rounds being skippable on a line and gives no claim for other round counts.

Success probability 1 means: one deterministic procedure (centres c_i = i tried in the order i = 1, 2, 3, ... until the first collision) was executed once from the start on the fixed target and stopped with a collision after 1 trials; the time is the executed operation count of that run with every trial charged, failed ones included, and the memory its executed peak. It is not a probability over centres; no start was selected beforehand.

heuristics.statement: The counts of proof.md sections 6 and 7 describe the executed program of proof.md section 9 under the stated rules: 1 per field operation (a Montgomery conversion is one multiplication), 1 per element load or store plus 1 address operation, 3 per loop iteration plus 2 per loop exit (the loops written with the macro FOR8 are unrolled eight times in the source and charged 3 per pass of eight; the generated kernels are straight-line), 1 per other executed index or control operation, 237 per reduced permutation evaluation, and two register files as the only register assumption: (a) for the small kernels, a block of 16 data words plus two working words (the twiddle operand and the butterfly temporary), 18 words of 256 bits, held as locals inside the stack bound of proof.md section 7; (b) for the big plans (transforms of length 2^12 to 2^15), a declared register file RF of 264 words of 256 bits (256 data words plus 8 working words), allocated once from the arena and therefore counted as memory (8,448 bytes of payload and a 64-byte header, inside memory_log2_bytes). Every transfer between an array and either register file is charged as the proof counts it: each load of a data word, of a twiddle or of the second pointwise operand, and each store back, costs 1 plus 1 address operation (LD(1) or ST(1) written beside the statement in the generated kernels); only accesses to a word already held in a register file are free.
heuristics.scope: All stages of the executed run of proof.md section 4 at the target dimensions (m = 39062 for the powering, N = 98304 and N' = 49152 in its transforms, 98304 evaluations of the line).
heuristics.extrapolation: None. The time is the executed total of one run of the shipped source, with every trial charged and the allocator, the report formatting, the single write and the exit charged in stage I; the only bounds in it are the stated per-byte, per-stage and system-call constants of proof.md section 4.2, each charged in full.
heuristics.limitations: The counts are produced by the instrumentation written into the source; the source is part of the proof text and was not run by the organizer. Word-level costs outside the stated rules (cache, bandwidth) are not part of the model.
